ohtani.title: Dominic Canzone has multi-homer game in Mariners' win
ohtani.blurb: Dominic Canzone has a multi-homer game in the Mariners' 7-6 win over the Dodgers

imanaga.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong's big day powers Cubs' win
imanaga.blurb: Pete Crow-Armstrong tallies three RBIs and Shota Imanaga tosses six scoreless innings in the Cubs' shutout win against the Pirates

suzuki.title: Alex Bregman, Seiya Suzuki fuel the Cubs' 10-2 win
suzuki.blurb: Alex Bregman and Seiya Suzuki each record three hits to power the Cubs' offensive eruption in the 10-2 win over the Cardinals

yoshida.title: Gage Jump spins six scoreless in A's win
yoshida.blurb: Gage Jump tosses six scoreless innings and Brian Serven homers in the A's 4-3 win over the Red Sox

okamoto.title: Back-to-back homers lead Nationals' offense in win
okamoto.blurb: Luis García Jr. and Dylan Crews hit back-to-back home runs and Clayton Beeter earns his 11th save in Nationals' 8-6 victory over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Gerrit Cole twirls six scoreless in Yankees' win
murakami.blurb: Early RBIs from Anthony Volpe and Max Schuemann, plus Gerrit Cole's six scoreless innings lead the Yankees to a 3-2 win over the White Sox

matsui.title: Machado and Merrill homer in Padres' comeback win
matsui.blurb: Padres rally late, led by game-tying and go-ahead homers by Manny Machado and Jackson Merrill, to beat the Marlins 5-3 and complete the sweep
